scope: Three immutable native1024x1024 saved grids, each16 fixed-latent256x256 outputs. No generator inference or checkpoint load.

ema_psi_0_7.face_detail: Several faces look more coherent and pleasantly rendered, with clearer eyes/mouths and hair texture, but r1c1 still has markedly dark malformed eyes. Some cheek planes and expressions remain unnatural; native256px detail is insufficient for the requested photographic standard.
ema_psi_0_7.collars: All sixteen tiles have recognizable white clerical tabs and black shirts.
ema_psi_0_7.no_hats: No obvious headwear across these sixteen tiles.

ema_psi_1.face_detail: Truncation is still hiding substantial failures. The first face has opaque dark eye smears; r3c3 has ghosted dark eyes and an unnatural face. Row2 column3 retains a sharply changing cheek plane and distorted expression. Several other mouths, cheeks, and necks remain smoothed or warped.
ema_psi_1.collars: Tabs recognizable in most tiles; r1c2 tiny/dim tab persists, and some necklines merge oddly with clothing.
ema_psi_1.no_hats: No obvious headwear in the fixed grid.

raw_psi_1.face_detail: Raw generator retains the same conspicuous eye failures at r1c1/r3c3 and warped cheek/expression at r2c3. Better individual tiles do not compensate for grossly malformed samples. Facial texture and mouth rendering are inconsistent.
raw_psi_1.collars: Priest clothing is reliably suggested, but r1c2 tab is tiny/dim and neckline quality varies.
raw_psi_1.no_hats: No obvious headwear in the fixed grid.

apparent_subjects: All grids consistently suggest adult masculine priest portraits. This does not establish subjective hot-only eligibility.
diversity_assessment: Some facial-hair, hair-curl and skin-tone variation is present, but similar long/oval proportions, dark swept hair, mild smiles, head angles, clerical-shirt framing and Roman architectural backgrounds dominate. These sixteen fixed latents show a narrow visual range; they do not establish unseen-latent diversity or a numerical collapse rate.
comparison_to_2500: Relative to2500 and2750, several truncated EMA faces appear modestly more coherent, but no robust recovery is evident: the same fixed samples still fail at eyes/cheeks without truncation, and the repeated face/layout pattern persists. Neither the recorded2500 rejection nor the production decision changes.
decision: Not approved. Preserve research evidence; facial artifacts and narrow visual diversity remain below the requested production standard.
limits: Sixteen fixed latent images per variant, each256x256; no unseen-latent generation, identity embedding, hotness score or distribution metric.
Displayed grids reviewed at their native1024x1024 size; a256px face tile cannot establish1024px photographic detail.
Only saved PNGs and prior review were read; generator/checkpoint state was not loaded or validated.
Synthetic apparent adult-male descriptions are visual presentation judgments, not facts about real people.
No active training data, trainer, checkpoint, or production deployment changed.
